description: Read-only Aave V4 loan-swap quote (borrowSwapQuote). Returns sell/buy amounts, slippage, and fee amounts. Does not prepare, sign, or submit an order — quote ids and approvals are not requested. debtPositionId is a UserBorrowItem id from get_v4_user_borrows. buyReserveId is the reserve to rotate into.

amount.description: Debt amount to swap, decimal string (e.g. "100")

buyReserveId.description: Reserve id of the asset to borrow instead

debtPositionId.description: UserBorrowItem id of the debt being swapped

selectedSlippage.description: Slippage as a decimal fraction string, e.g. "0.01" for 1%

name: get_v4_borrow_swap_quote
